media.alt: Orange iPhone Pro campaign poster with a model presenting the device in forced perspective.
Violet Samsung Ultra campaign poster with a model, smartphone, and S Pen in forced perspective.

method: Select one variant, preserve its layered composition, and adapt the product, palette, headline, copy, and four feature modules without mixing the two art directions.

variants.label: Apple Pro poster
variants.promptText:
Prompt : 

FORMAT:
4:5 vertical premium smartphone campaign poster, ultra-high resolution (8K), global OOH + digital + social ready
Style: Apple-level minimalism × bold Gen-Z composition × hyper-real commercial photography

🧠 CORE INTENT:
“PRO, WITHOUT TRYING.”

Effortless power.
Quiet confidence.
No noise — just precision.

🎬 SCENE COMPOSITION:

BACKGROUND:
Pure matte white canvas with a dominant rounded rectangle block in ultra-vibrant burnt orange gradient (top-left → bottom-right glow)

GIANT TYPOGRAPHY (BACKGROUND LAYER):
“PRO”
- ultra-bold geometric sans-serif
- stretched wide kerning
- partially cropped by frame edges
- soft shadow depth
- color: deep orange slightly darker than background block
- subtle emboss effect

👤 SUBJECT (HUMAN ELEMENT):

- Female model, clean editorial look (Apple casting style)
- Neutral expression (confident, calm, not smiling)
- Hair: natural flow, slightly wind-touched
- Outfit:
  → muted tones (off-white + deep maroon jacket)
  → minimal styling, no distractions

POSE:
- Shot from slightly low angle (hero perspective)
- One hand extended toward camera holding iPhone
- Body slightly angled for depth
- Face aligned toward viewer (eye contact)

📱 PRODUCT (HERO FOCUS):

DEVICE:
iPhone 17 Pro in Titanium Orange finish

POSITION:
- Extreme foreground (forced perspective)
- Slight tilt to reveal camera module depth

DETAILING:
- triple camera system hyper-sharp
- lens reflections physically accurate
- brushed titanium edge highlights
- micro-scratches + realistic material response
- Apple logo centered, subtle reflective gloss

REFLECTION:
- soft studio reflection on device edges
- micro light bloom around camera rings

✨ LIGHTING SYSTEM:

MAIN LIGHT:
Soft studio key light (front-left)
→ smooth skin tones
→ clean product highlights

RIM LIGHT:
Warm edge light from right
→ enhances phone silhouette
→ highlights metallic edges

ACCENT LIGHT:
Subtle glow from background orange block

SHADOW:
Soft drop shadow under subject + phone
(no harsh contrast)

🎨 COLOR SYSTEM:

- Primary: Apple Orange (hero)
- Secondary: Clean white
- Accent: warm highlights + skin tones
- Contrast: deep micro-shadows

No over-saturation.
No neon.
Controlled premium palette.

✨ GRAPHIC ELEMENTS:

- Minimal sparkle icons ✦ (2–3 only)
- Soft floating UI pill (glass morphism)
- Very subtle grain for realism

✍️ TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM:

TOP LEFT:
Apple logo (black, small, clean)

TOP RIGHT:
“Built for Apple Intelligence.” (thin sans-serif)

MID LEFT (pill):
“iPhone 17 Pro”

CENTER DOMINANT:
“PRO” (background type)

BOTTOM RIGHT (body text):
Small paragraph:

“iPhone 17 Pro. Uncompromising power.
A19 Pro chip. Advanced camera system.
Designed for what’s next.”

📊 FEATURE STRIP (BOTTOM GRID):

4 rounded cards (glass-white panels):

1. A19 PRO CHIP  
   “Unstoppable performance.”

2. 48MP PRO CAMERA  
   “Total creative control.”

3. 4K DOLBY VISION  
   “Cinematic in every frame.”

4. APPLE INTELLIGENCE  
   “Personal. Private. Powerful.”

Icons minimal line style

📐 COMPOSITION GRID:

- Top: brand + statement
- Mid: subject + product (dominant)
- Background: typography layer
- Bottom: feature modules

Eye flow:
Face → Phone → Camera → “PRO” → Features

🎥 CAMERA SPECS:

- ARRI Alexa Mini LF
- 50mm anamorphic lens
- shallow depth of field
- HDR rendering
- ultra-real skin + material detail
- slight lens distortion for realism

variants.label: Samsung Ultra poster
variants.promptText:
Samsung prompt : 

FORMAT:
4:5 vertical premium smartphone campaign poster, ultra-high resolution (8K), global OOH + digital + social ready
Style: Samsung futuristic tech aesthetic × bold Gen-Z composition × hyper-real commercial photography

🧠 CORE INTENT:
“ULTRA, WITHOUT LIMITS.”

Power that stretches beyond hardware.
Intelligence that adapts in real time.
Built for everything you throw at it.

🎬 SCENE COMPOSITION:

BACKGROUND:
Deep cosmic gradient (black → electric violet → deep blue)
+ subtle radial glow from center

GIANT TYPOGRAPHY (BACKGROUND LAYER):
“ULTRA”
- ultra-bold extended sans-serif
- glowing edges (neon violet)
- partially masked behind subject
- slight motion blur streak horizontally
- futuristic depth layering

GRID OVERLAY:
Very subtle sci-fi grid (low opacity)
adds tech depth

👤 SUBJECT (HUMAN ELEMENT):

- Male or female, sharp futuristic styling
- Expression: focused, intense, slightly detached
- Styling: techwear (black / reflective fabrics)

POSE:
- Dynamic angle (slightly leaning forward)
- One hand extended holding phone toward camera
- Other hand holding S-Pen (gesture mid-air)

Camera angle:
slightly low + tilted (adds motion energy)

📱 PRODUCT (HERO FOCUS):

DEVICE:
Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra in Phantom Black / Titanium Grey

POSITION:
- extreme foreground dominance
- angled to show camera lenses + sharp edges

DETAILING:
- quad camera lenses hyper-real glass reflections
- subtle lens glow (AI vision feel)
- matte back texture visible
- sharp chamfered edges highlighted
- S-Pen visible near device

REFLECTION:
- controlled reflection on device edges
- micro light streaks across lenses

✨ LIGHTING SYSTEM:

MAIN LIGHT:
Cool white key light (front-left)
→ defines subject + device edges

RIM LIGHT:
Neon violet / electric blue edge light
→ outlines silhouette
→ emphasizes futuristic feel

ACCENT LIGHT:
Moving light streak reflections across device

SHADOW:
High contrast but controlled (tech aesthetic)

🎨 COLOR SYSTEM:

- Primary: deep black / graphite
- Accent: neon violet + electric blue
- Secondary: cool white highlights

High contrast, futuristic palette

✨ GRAPHIC ELEMENTS:

- light streaks (motion trails)
- glowing particles (very subtle)
- UI fragments floating (AI hint)
- grid + scan lines (low opacity)

✍️ TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM:

TOP LEFT:
Samsung logo (white, minimal)

TOP RIGHT:
“Galaxy AI inside.” (thin futuristic sans-serif)

MID LEFT (pill):
“Galaxy S25 Ultra”

CENTER DOMINANT:
“ULTRA” (background type)

BOTTOM RIGHT (body text):

“Galaxy S25 Ultra. Engineered without limits.
200MP precision. AI-powered zoom.
Performance that adapts to you.”

📊 FEATURE STRIP (BOTTOM GRID):

4 glass-dark panels:

1. 200MP CAMERA  
   “Extreme clarity.”

2. AI ZOOM  
   “See beyond distance.”

3. SNAPDRAGON ELITE  
   “Next-gen performance.”

4. S-PEN  
   “Precision control.”

Icons: minimal neon line icons

📐 COMPOSITION GRID:

- Top: brand + statement
- Mid: subject + product (dominant)
- Background: ULTRA typography
- Bottom: feature modules

Eye flow:
Face → Phone → Camera → Glow → Features

🎥 CAMERA SPECS:

- ARRI Alexa Mini LF
- 50mm anamorphic
- shallow DOF
- HDR lighting
- cinematic contrast
- slight lens distortion for realism

purpose: Reuse a proven campaign hierarchy while keeping each brand direction independent.
summary: Two premium 4:5 smartphone campaign directions pair product-first forced perspective with distinct Apple-inspired and Samsung-inspired art systems.
title: Pro and Ultra Smartphone Campaign Posters
